subject: Learning Methods
title: The External Storage Benefit
description: A fast breakdown of The External Storage Benefit for builders.

hook.text: Memory fades. Notes don't. Your future self will thank you for writing down what your present self understood.

buildup.text: The external storage benefit means notes serve as a permanent record you can revisit weeks, months, or years later.

discovery.text: Good notes extend your memory beyond biological limits. They become a second brain that doesn't forget.

twist.text: Unorganized notes are useless for retrieval. If you can't find a note when you need it, it doesn't exist functionally.

climax.text: Notes need both capture and organization. A consistent system for labeling, dating, and filing makes retrieval possible.

punchline.text: A note you can't find is a note you don't have.

quiz.question: What makes the external storage benefit of notes effective?
options: Writing as many notes as possible
Having a system for organizing and retrieving notes later
